API: Theme.of returns "The data from the closest Theme instance that encloses the given context." and "Defaults to ThemeData.fallback if there is no Theme in the given build context." Cookbook: "looks up the widget tree and retrieves the nearest `Theme` ... If not, Flutter applies the app's theme." claim_verdicts.suggested_text: A value that changes with light and dark belongs in the theme: `Theme.of(context)` returns the `ThemeData` of the nearest theme above the widget, which in DonHang.App is the app's theme, the object that holds the theme in force.

claim_verdicts.evidence: Docs: "Use `const` constructors on widgets as much as possible, since they allow Flutter to short-circuit most of the rebuild work."
